S40.02.note: The Memory row only appears when signed in. The same memory can also be added in chat with a message starting "Remember that ..." (packages/ai/agent-core/src/memory.ts), which is not a separate background setting.
steps: Sign in, then click the ⋮ button labelled More at the top right of the side panel.
Click Memory in the menu. The Memory dialog opens.
Click the box labelled "Add something for AGI to remember" and type a line of background about yourself, for example your situation or interests.
Compare: the message "Memory saved." appears and your line shows in the list. In a new chat, check that replies take it into account.
S40.02.where: More (⋮, top right) > Memory > New memory field > Add
